scope: Broadcast:Relay official Shopify listing preview and read-only rendered browser accessibility trees; no shopper actions, screenshot, viewport measurement, mobile, editor, checkout or performance tests.

sources.observation: The official Relay preset page's View demo preview displayed a storefront branded broadcast-theme-relay.

claims.observed: All-products collection exposes product-type, size, color and availability filters, while the PDP shows size/color option availability and sizing help.
claims.risk: Rendered controls do not establish filter functionality or correct inventory/variant data.
claims.vsn_guard: Validate filter-to-variant consistency and actual behavior before using as functional precedent.

claims.observed: Storefront shows sale, final-sale, low-inventory, material/sustainability, shipping and promotional statements.
claims.risk: These are unverified demo merchant claims.
claims.vsn_guard: Require current merchant evidence and policy before surfacing trust, urgency or inventory claims.
